evals.prompt: I'm new to HQ, set it up for my business
evals.expected_output: Checks doctor, businesses and status first; installs or fixes what doctor names; runs /hq:new-business if there's no business; sets up backups before anything else; then walks departments in the start-here order using each guide, one step at a time.
expectations: Ran `npm run hq -- doctor` and read the status before asking questions
Opened the department's guide from docs/guides and followed its sections in order
Never asked for a password, key or token in chat

evals.expected_output: Opens docs/guides/finance.md, checks what's already live, walks Before you start, Tools, Accounts, Skills, Check it's working, and ticks Done when; saves a progress note to the vault.
expectations: Ran the guide's checks and showed the results
Saved a progress note with save-plan

evals.expected_output: Reads doctor and the status API, lists departments that aren't equipped or whose guides aren't done, in start-here order, with the next step and its time.
expectations: Read live state (doctor and /api/status) rather than guessing
Listed remaining departments in the start-here order
